Every row of contoso_served.dim_product — all 2,517 products — with no restriction applied whatsoever: no sales filter, no date window, no channel predicate, no trading-state predicate. Nothing needed applying. The sales fork was measured and selects the identical set (2,517 of 2,517 products have at least one sales line; 11 of 11 brands have a sale), dim_product carries no discontinued or validity column so no date restriction is even expressible, and store.resolution.the_channel_is_the_location_sentinel is declared `applies: subject` where this question's subject is a Product and not a Store, so its `physical` default does not reach here.
